def_en: 1) that, for, because, when, as though, as, because that, but, then, certainly, except, surely, since
1b1) when, if, though (with a concessive force)
1e) that if, for if, indeed if, for though, but if
kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
expl: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
etim: a primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent;
